headline: Screaming Eagles Bench Drake Maye's 38.85 Points and Still Win by 20
meme_brief: A team starts their backup quarterback instead of a guy who throws for nearly 39 points, wins the game comfortably anyway because their receiver went off for 40, and nobody even has to talk about the QB decision.
recap:
The headline number this week belongs to Tetairoa McMillan, who put up 40.2 points for Screaming Eagles, the league's top individual score, in a 123.35-120.05 win over Waffle House. It barely mattered that Screaming Eagles started Matthew Stafford (14.85) over Drake Maye, who sat on the bench and scored 38.85 — a 24-point bench error that would sink most teams but got buried under McMillan's day and a comfortable final margin.

The closest game of the week was Silverbacks over mikelanta, 123.2-120.7, decided by 2.5 points. mikelanta got 32.4 from Kenneth Walker and 21.1 from Jacoby Brissett but left Rome Odunze (12.4) on the bench in favor of Josh Downs (3.1), a 9.3-point swing that would have erased the deficit and then some. Silverbacks won anyway despite sitting Michael Penix's 17.95 points in favor of Marcus Mariota's 5.8 — two bad benching decisions in the same matchup, and only one team paid for it.

The biggest blowout was Joe Mama Angie Daddy's 143.9-96.65 win over demon44, a 47.25-point margin. Brock Purdy (29.8) and Javonte Williams (31.8) both started and delivered, but the top scorer on the roster was actually Joe Burrow, who sat and put up 34 points — the margin was so lopsided it didn't cost them. demon44, which had been scraping together a competitive roster off free-agent pickups, got buried behind Bryce Young going for 30.75 points from the bench while Trevor Lawrence started and managed only 18.35.

Pukachu Chews You beat Chuba Bucky Doo 149.25-124.45, with Bijan Robinson (31.2) and Emanuel Wilson (27.5) doing the heavy lifting. Chuba Bucky Doo got 33.25 from Kirk Cousins but left Chris Rodriguez's 10.5 points on the bench in favor of Kalif Raymond's 1.6, an 8.9-point gift to an opponent that didn't need it.
transaction_desk:
Meredith's Fan Club made the week's only real gamble, burning a premium No. 3 waiver priority on tight end Oronde Gadsden, who returned 6.3 points in his first week on the roster — not nothing, but not yet a return on a genuinely costly bid. demon44 and mikelanta also used waiver priority this week, but both were already sitting at the back of the order (No. 12 and No. 9, respectively), so burning them cost next to nothing regardless of outcome. demon44's claim on Bryce Young paid off immediately with 30.75 points.

Silverbacks added Michael Penix as an uncontested free-agent pickup and got 17.95 points out of him in his first week — only to bench him for Marcus Mariota, as noted above. That's a strange outcome for a roster move that worked exactly as hoped on paper. Joe Mama Angie Daddy's add of Sione Vaki, a likely injury-insurance pickup behind Jahmyr Gibbs, is a sensible depth move regardless of this week's modest 2.2-point return. Everything else on the wire — Jauan Jennings, Kalif Raymond, Darren Waller, Isaiah Davis — came and went without costing anyone priority, which is what uncontested waivers look like in a league with this much bench churn.

standings_narrative:
The three division leaders currently set up as Joe Mama Angie Daddy (Diamonds, 3-1), Chuba Bucky Doo (Hearts, 2-2) and Pukachu Chews You (Clubs, 2-2) for seeds 1 through 3. Dak to the Future (3-1) and Long Live King Henry (2-2) fill the next two spots on record alone. The sixth and final seed doesn't go to the next-best record — it goes to mikelanta, who despite sitting at 1-3 has piled up more season points than every other team outside the top five, putting them into the playoff field ahead of teams with better win totals.

That leaves Screaming Eagles on the outside looking in as the closest team by points among the rest, with Silverbacks, Waffle House, Broke Dak Mountain, Meredith's Fan Club and demon44 all fighting for positioning behind them. Several of those teams are within a game and a tiebreaker of changing this picture completely.
look_ahead:
Next week's matchups: Chuba Bucky Doo faces Silverbacks, Joe Mama Angie Daddy faces Broke Dak Mountain, Waffle House faces Meredith's Fan Club, Long Live King Henry faces Screaming Eagles, Dak to the Future faces demon44, and mikelanta faces Pukachu Chews You.

The mikelanta-Pukachu Chews You matchup is worth watching given mikelanta's points-based standing despite its record, and Dak to the Future gets a shot to pad its margin against a demon44 roster still searching for its footing after a 47-point loss.

running_jokes: Bench mismanagement remains a near-universal problem, but this week it mostly didn't cost anyone — Screaming Eagles, Silverbacks, and Meredith's Fan Club all won despite real bench mistakes.
mikelanta keeps scoring like a playoff team and losing like a rebuild, and the points-based tiebreaker now has them in the playoff picture anyway at 1-3.
demon44's cheap-waiver roster hit a real wall with a 47-point loss to Joe Mama Angie Daddy.
